title: Chat with the leader
keyboardSend: Ctrl/⌘ + Enter to send. Enter adds a new line.
mcpNames: Configured MCP server names, one per line
mcpHint: Use names already configured in the local Codex. Do not paste credentials. Bee Team keeps its own MCP connected.
skillRoots: Additional skill directories, one absolute path per line
skillsHint: Installed skills are discovered by Codex. Additional directories are optional; unavailable skills are not installed automatically.
unavailable: Integrated chat requires a compatible Bee Team API.
external: Continue using your assistant with MCP and skills. Bee Team does not control that external chat.
empty: Plan your work with the leader. You do not need to create a task first.
uncertainSend: The send result is unknown. Check the same request before sending another message.
readOnly: This chat belongs to a previous binding. Open a chat for the current session to send messages.
replace: I want to replace the current agent binding with a new integrated session, preserving its history.
setupHint: Bee Team uses the agent’s own workspace and preserves previous session history.
needs_auth: Sign in to Codex on this computer before continuing.
runtime_unavailable: The local session is unavailable. Check the Codex installation and the Bee Team server configuration.
uncertain: Execution result is uncertain. Await reconciliation before sending again.
connectionFailed: Could not connect to the chat.
incompatible: The chat event format is incompatible. Update the app and API.
turn_in_progress: Wait for the current execution to finish.
version_conflict: This request changed. Refresh before trying again.
external_mode: This agent uses an external session.
session_not_ready: The session is not ready. Refresh its status.
session_binding_conflict: The active session changed. Refresh the chat.
approval_expired: This approval is no longer pending.
not_found: This chat or resource was not found.
unsupported_capability: This capability is not supported by the current integration.
session_busy: This agent has an active execution or delivery. Wait for it to finish before changing the session.
session_creation_uncertain: Session creation is pending reconciliation. Check the same request; do not create another session.
provider_unavailable: Codex is unavailable. Check its installation and retry.
invalid_tool_profile: Check the configured tool names and directories.
setupUncertain: The creation result is unknown. Your settings are preserved while you check the same request.
reconcilePending: The provider has not confirmed the result yet. No message was resent. You can check again.
binding_chat_conflict: This session already has a chat in another team. Open that team or create a different session.
local_action_forbidden: This action requires an authorized local origin. Open Bee Team through its configured local address.
